dependencies: Actual pinned SDK dsound.h COM types/macros, native DirectSound buffers/device with real Stop/Release/DuplicateSoundBuffer/GetCurrentPosition
Real BHWave PCM owner supplies adapter-created buffer; original full option/file sound loader 0047b950 remains WIP
Explicit listener/context replaces one original ten-float listener record and global resource/voice pointer arrays
contracts: Resource and voice pointer tables start at 16 and grow floor(capacity*1.25); freelists preserve IDs; voice reuse increments 16-bit generation

Buffered resources use up to three native buffers; take first empty voice slot, otherwise duplicate base until capped or failed, then replace strict greatest distance/progress score; first tie wins and equal-score request is admitted
Spatial score is nearest active listener squared distance (one original listener); non-positioned baseline 0.01; buffer progress multiplies by bytes/(bytes-play_cursor)
Replacement increments old voice generation before freeing; allocation from the same free slot increments again; handles pack index|generation<<16
0047c050/0047c140 use original signed division by 65536, not a logical unsigned high-half extraction; high-generation negative handles do not validate
Streaming requests prepend a doubly linked source list and keep buffer/voice selection distinct from actual playback; Stop unlinks either kind and invalidates generation
Request/update dB=base+max(1000*log2(level),-10000); pitch multiplies base frequency; zero level uses floor; position/velocity flags clear without clearing old coordinates
limits: Functional PC53 moderate finite inputs; CRT log is a functional counterpart to x87 logarithms, no byte-match/NaN payload equivalence claim
Invalid indices, failing COM calls, bad PCM/options or allocation failure reject safely rather than original unchecked accesses
Adapter creates PCM buffers using original control flags; full original parser, listener transform and deferred playback/update owner remain unrecovered
Native tests never call Play or write primary/system volume; original game code is never executed
Fresh bytes otherwise unspecified by original malloc are zero initialized; recycled record payload is preserved. Zero-level dB floor does not claim original x87 exception-status equivalence.
